data.name: Namya
data.gender_notes: Namya is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Hindu mythology, Namya is a name of the goddess Saraswati, the deity of knowledge, learning, and art. It is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘namas’, meaning ‘to bow’ or ‘to offer obeisance’. The name signifies the act of seeking knowledge and offering respect to the divine source of wisdom. The name Namya carries the meaning “Name of the Goddess” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Namya usually hope their child will grow to embody name of the goddess and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Namya belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Name of the Goddess.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Namya total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.
